notes: Stories created for MAINT-CONSENT covering schema, logic, API, tests, and integration.

change_log.value: Added schema/contract story for consent tiers and edge cases
Added core logic bug fix story for two-tier consent flow
Added API integration story for consent handling
Added test suite for consent edge cases
Added integration story with lead capture and unknown question flows

MAINT-CONSENT-S1.title: Define Consent Schema and Edge Case Contract
MAINT-CONSENT-S1.description: Audit and correct the Pydantic consent models and domain schema to fully represent two-tier HIPAA consent, including explicit handling for partial consent, revoked consent, and missing user responses.

MAINT-CONSENT-S2.title: Fix Two-Tier Consent Logic and State Transitions
MAINT-CONSENT-S2.description: Correct defects in ConsentService to ensure proper progression between Tier 1 and Tier 2 consent, including handling retries, invalid transitions, and ensuring de-identification is enforced when Tier 2 is not granted.

MAINT-CONSENT-S3.title: Expose Corrected Consent Behavior via API and Tool Router
MAINT-CONSENT-S3.description: Ensure corrected consent logic is properly surfaced through FastAPI endpoints and tool_router interactions, including consistent responses for consent prompts, failures, and state persistence across chat turns.

MAINT-CONSENT-S4.title: Consent Flow Unit and Edge Case Test Suite
MAINT-CONSENT-S4.description: Implement unit tests covering consent tier transitions, denial paths, repeated prompts, and de-identification enforcement, including regression tests for previously observed defects.

MAINT-CONSENT-S5.title: Integrate Consent Fixes with Lead Capture and Unknown Question Flows
MAINT-CONSENT-S5.description: Validate and correct integration points where consent is invoked in lead_capture_service and unknown_question_service, ensuring consistent consent enforcement and no leakage of identifiable data without Tier 2 approval.

MAINT-CONSENT.mitigation: Add regression tests for all consent paths and enforce strict state validation in service layer
